The ABN record you linked relates to the Australian legal entity. For context, K2 Battery is part of the K2 Energy group, which was founded in the US in 2005. We established our Australian operation in 2023, and the group’s headquarters have since relocated to Australia.
You can read more about our background here: K2 Energy — About Us .
Within the group, K2 Energy focuses on outdoor and drone battery applications, while K2 Battery focuses on energy storage. We also have an e-commerce platform launching soon for our broader product range. Home storage is one part of our battery business, rather than a business established solely around the current subsidy program.
We’re a Clean Energy Council member and a NETCC Approved Seller, and we operate our own warehouse at 12A Redland Drive, Mitcham VIC 3132. You’re welcome to arrange a visit, meet the team and see our wider product range.
Happy to clarify the company structure and provide supporting information.
[Corapmafya] Hi Op, can you comment on the technical difference (if any) between the two battery brands you have up for offer?
[K2 Battery] Good question! Both use lithium iron phosphate (LFP) cells, but the main differences in our packages are:
HYXi:A high-voltage battery paired with HYXi inverters, keeping the battery, inverter and monitoring within the same manufacturer’s ecosystem. The HYXi model in this offer supports up to four battery modules per stack. Our 30kWh package therefore uses two battery stacks and two inverters operating in parallel.
Pytes:A low-voltage, nominal 51.2V modular battery paired with a compatible Solis or Deye inverter. Our 30kWh package uses one inverter, with monitoring through the selected inverter’s platform.
For the 30kWh options, the two-stack/two-inverter HYXi layout versus the single-inverter Pytes layout is also worth considering when comparing installation space and equipment.

[AccioHagrid] I installed batteries + solar in 2023 - before there were any rebates on batteries in NSW. Would I still be eligible to install another inverter + battery at these prices?
[K2 Battery] Hi, potentially yes! Having a battery installed in 2023 doesn’t automatically rule you out. If no federal battery STCs have previously been claimed at the property, additional battery capacity may still qualify, subject to the scheme’s requirements.
Please send us your existing battery and inverter models, and address privately. We can check eligibility and whether the advertised package suits your setup.
